card.name: Word after a time or distance amount
card.fires_on: The word right after a number plus unit that completes the phrase, such as duration, time, apart, off, greater, more or long. It is most often a time span or spacing.

modes.label: Time span noun
modes.description: A noun like duration or time that follows a period of years or months.
modes.example: three years<< duration>> have shown an increased risk of serious cardiovascular

modes.label: Spacing or comparison word
modes.description: A word like apart, off, long, greater or more after a measure, percent or day count.

modes.label: Days off
modes.description: The word off after days, meaning time away.
modes.example: explored the Kaibab Forest roads on their days<< off>>, and traveled back home to Salt Lake
